status.summary: Former two-time UFC middleweight champion on a four-fight losing streak: Strickland (UD, Sep 2023), Du Plessis (RNC, Aug 2024), Imavov (KO, Feb 2025), Joe Pyfer (TKO R2, UFC Seattle, Mar 28, 2026). Pro record 24-6. He rejected retirement, left City Kickboxing for a smaller camp in Sydney, and is reported to headline UFC Saudi Arabia against Shara Magomedov on Dec 5, 2026.
status.ranking: Somewhere from #9 to #15 at middleweight (UFC media poll as mirrored by Kalshi, Oct 2026; exact spot unconfirmed)
status.next_fight: Reported, not officially announced as of mid/late-Oct coverage: vs Sharabutdin 'Shara Bullet' Magomedov, five-round main event, UFC Saudi Arabia, ANB Arena, Riyadh, Dec 5, 2026 (first reported by Ariel Helwani on Oct 15, 2026).

signature: layered feints with a low lead hand, the jab hidden behind them (Sherdog Film Room; Fight Primer)
counter punching against aggressive opponents (UCSD Guardian; Fight Primer)
calf and lead-leg kicks (battered Pyfer's calf in R1, Mar 2026; reddened Whittaker's lead leg)
kicks and knees at range: knee to the head and body attacks vs Pyfer
right hand at distance: KO of Alex Pereira, R2, UFC 287 (Apr 2023)
weaknesses: grappling exchanges: submitted by Du Plessis (RNC, R4, Aug 2024) and finished by Pyfer's ground strikes after a back take (R2, Mar 2026)
sustained forward pressure: Strickland dropped him in R1 and won 49-46 on all cards (Sep 2023)
three straight stoppage losses; KO'd by Imavov's right hand 30 seconds into R2 (Feb 2025)
takedown defense down to 72% decayed from 76% career, with opponents shooting about 5 times per fight (decayed 21.4 attempts over 4.1 fight-weights)
style.summary: A long switch-stance kickboxer who wins on feints, distance and counters, attacking the legs and body from the outside. He keeps winning first rounds on output (20-8 vs Imavov, 24-9 vs Pyfer) and then gets finished. His last three losses were all stoppages, from punches, ground strikes and a choke.

moves.notes: Target groups follow fighters.json decayed sums: sig attempts 67.7% head, 15.5% body, 16.8% leg (career 67.9/14.5/17.6). The middleweight league split is about 77/14/9, so he sends roughly twice the league share to the legs. He also lands 95% of his sig strikes at distance, so clinch and ground weights stay minimal. Inside the head group, sources stress the feinted jab and counter punching, which puts the jab first and the cross and hooks next. Head kicks get 0.18 because he is a kickboxer by trade, though no source in this pass counts them. Body is weighted to kicks because his body work comes from range (26/29 body landed vs Du Plessis, 38/60 vs Strickland, all at distance). Calf leads inside on the legs, since Pyfer coverage describes him 'battering' the calf. The knee is set at 0.1 for the knee to the head vs Pyfer. Spinning is a small 0.06 judgment, not sourced in this pass.

appearance.build: very tall and slim (6'4", 80" reach per dataset), long limbs and a lean torso
appearance.hair: short dark hair; styling and colour vary from fight to fight (no confirmed 2026 description found)
appearance.facial_hair: light: a thin moustache and chin hair in many published photos; varies
appearance.tattoos: Sourced: 'Broken Native' script and a map of Africa (Lagos highlighted) on the chest; yin-yang inside a Kurama seal on the abdomen; Deadpool on the left ribcage; Toph Beifong (Avatar) on the right inner forearm; Calvin and Hobbes on a bicep; Arabic 'Dragon' by an eyebrow (sources disagree on which side); a neck piece most reports identify as the Egyptian war god Montu; small feather marks reported beside the right eye.

engine_notes.note: Wins R1 on volume, then gets finished in R2: he led Imavov 20-8 and Pyfer 24-9 in sig strikes in R1 and was stopped in R2 both times.
Three KO/TKO losses on his record (Pereira 2022, Imavov 2025, Pyfer 2026) plus the Du Plessis submission. Decayed opponent sig accuracy is 48.5% against him, up from 44.2% career.
Almost no offensive grappling: 0.06 takedowns per 15 min decayed, 3% control share. Opponents hold 14% control share against him.
In five-round fights, output in R2-R5 runs 1.18-1.44x R1 across 15 such fights, so he starts measured.
